description: Semantic code navigation and query operations

operations.name: q
operations.description: Run a typed mi-lsp query pipeline

operations.name: wiki_graph
operations.description: Query the unified wiki and code graph

operations.name: wiki_validate_contract
operations.description: Validate WIKI-CONTRACT-v1 and its language-aware checks

operations.name: repair
operations.description: Plan or explicitly apply local repairs

operations.name: search
operations.description: Search text; bounded matches, optional content

operations.name: refs
operations.description: Find symbol references; optional file/line anchor

operations.name: find_symbol
operations.description: Find a symbol with bounded intent, definition, semantic references, and source ranges; cold/catalog results are approximate. Qualified or Unicode Go names may use approximate intent rather than exact-name lookup

output_schema.description: Response governed by find_symbol/v0; item status and partial/detail fields distinguish checked results from incomplete results

operations.name: rename_symbol
operations.description: Apply a versioned gopls rename after live prepareRename confirmation. Bare symbol names never auto-select because workspace/symbol completeness is unproven; select a prepareRename-validated opaque candidate.symbol and retry using the same symbol input field. Candidate lists are bounded and candidates_complete=false; file/line/column remain optional all-or-none selectors. Compilation remains unchecked. change_signature is unavailable without a semantic backend plan

symbol.description: Bare Go identifier requests a bounded candidate list and never auto-renames; or pass a returned opaque candidate.symbol selector in this same field

output_schema.description: Response governed by rename_symbol/v0; item status and partial/detail fields distinguish checked results from incomplete results

symbol.description: Versioned opaque mi-lsp-symbol:v1 selector; untrusted and valid only after workspace, repo, path, snapshot, and live prepareRename checks

operations.name: get_errors
operations.description: Semantic diagnostics for up to 64 canonical explicit paths (repeat --file or positional), or changed source paths; partial/not_checked is not clean and diagnostics do not prove compilation

output_schema.description: Response governed by get_errors/v0; item status and partial/detail fields distinguish checked results from incomplete results

operations.name: diagnostics
operations.description: Errors/warnings after editing a file or changed files; partial is not clean

operations.name: find-files
operations.description: Find filenames/globs respecting ignore rules; no index
